classes.description: Setup — 换线/设置定义实体。定义生产设备从一种产品/工艺切换到另一种时所需的物理配置变更规则，包括模具要求、轨道宽度、工装夹具等配置项。Part 通过 currentSetup 字段引用当前 Setup 状态。 【Swagger】Schema: SetupEntity；来源文件: Setups.json；API: /api/Setups。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: documentSet
properties.description: 关联的换线指导文档集 → DocumentSet 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: stdSetupLaborTime
properties.description: 执行此设置所需的总工时，用于绩效对标报告。 【Swagger】Total time (labor hours) required to perform this Setup. This will be different than elapsed time if more than one person is required. This value is available for performance-to-standard reporting.

properties.name: resourceGroup
properties.description: 换线适用的设备组 → ResourceGroup 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: status
properties.description: 当前状态：1=活动，2=非活动。 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 修订版（基础实体上下文内唯一）。 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标 ID 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器（WIPMsgDefMgr）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: stdSetupTime
properties.description: 执行此设置的经过时间，用于周期时间计算。 【Swagger】Elapsed time required to perform this Setup. This is the standard (estimate) used for cycle time calculations.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list
